name: Jade Jungle Temple — surface and detail kit
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: A steep jade/verdigris stepped temple with central stairs, gold seam bands, lotus-like roof crest and pointed gilded portals at successive terraces. Palms and fern planting frame the broad base; isometric shows compact setbacks rather than separate boxed wings. Hidden layout inference: Use a small shaded clearing as arrival, one strong central stair for the hero approach and a quieter side route linking terrace landings. Plant pockets flank entrances rather than blocking portals; make the upper shrine a framed destination with depth. Hidden rear return is inferred. Preserve this local design. Exactly12 isolated main components in a clean4-column grid. No missing/empty slots or repeated subjects counted twice. One clear front/three-quarter view with useful small rear/top/contact inset per cell. Truly flat backs for appliques, square join ends for repeat mouldings. Screens have repeated coherent holes, no tangled tendrils. Windows separate glass from surrounds, cornices/parapets and posts separate where named. Do not include large room/scenery fragments attached to a tiny detail. Title "B15-DETAIL-001 — Jade Jungle Temple — surface and detail kit". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need beveled/setback wall hosts, terrace/step returns, portal reveal/lotus crest seat and gold band corners. Existing jade/lotus/gold patterns retained, not recoloured to palace marble. Distinct jungle canopy/palms/vines/epiphytes and birds/geckos/beetles still require audit; shared moss/rocks/water reused. Missing detached construction pieces and local interior-facing patterns.
